configurePresets.name: mingw64
configurePresets.description: Cross-compile the .8bf on Linux/CachyOS. Produces a working Windows x64 DLL for ABI/logic testing. Emits compile_commands.json for clangd/CLion/VS Code.

configurePresets.name: msvc
configurePresets.description: The shipping build. Requires Visual Studio 2026 (Community edition is fine) or Build Tools, and CMake >= 4.2 for the VS 2026 generator. Imports kernel32 + user32 + gdi32 only.

configurePresets.name: msvc2022
configurePresets.description: The shipping build on the older VS 2022 (v143) toolchain, for machines without VS 2026. Same output invariants as the msvc preset.
